evidence.quote:
one bundle per run per person, not one
> message per skill
one thing to read, not four

observations.why: The prescription is structured through matched negative-contrast pairs ('one X, not Y') setting the chosen boundary against its rejected alternative.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Does the utterance formulate an operational rule by explicitly contrasting what is prescribed against what is rejected in matched clauses?
